notes: 2.11.2 As in the past, the four metropolitan cities Calcutta, Delhi and Mumbai reported higher
number of Suicides. These four cities have reporicd almost half (48.9%) of the suicides reported from 23 mega
cities. While and Mumbai reporied increases of 33.8 percent and 8.1 percent respectively, Chennai and
Delhi reported decreases over previous year. Among the other cities, Surat (63.3%) and Patna (38.7%) reported
significant rise in the suicides in 1998 over 1997. The cities such as Ahmedabad (20.9%) and Jaipur (14.5%)
registered significant fall in the suicides that were reported during 1998 compared to 1997.
